categories.main_business_segments: Shanghai Haoyuan Chemexpress Co., Ltd. operates primarily in pharmaceutical research and development services, focusing on small molecule and new molecular type drug discovery, including molecular building blocks, tool compounds, biochemical reagents, pharmaceutical intermediates, active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs), and drug formulations. The company provides integrated CRO (Contract Research Organization) and CDMO (Contract Development and Manufacturing Organization) services covering the entire drug development and production chain from initial materials to finished formulations.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced technologies such as high-throughput screening, flow chemistry, biocatalysis, photochemical reactions, asymmetric synthesis, chiral catalysis, and continuous flow photoreactors. It has developed multiple core technology platforms including high-activity APIs (HPAPI), multi-chiral complex drug synthesis, vitamin D derivative APIs, drug solid-state chemistry, and conjugated drug platforms (ADC, PROTAC, XDC). It also employs GMP-compliant production processes, including kilogram-scale synthesis, crystallization, and formulation technologies like hot melt extrusion and spray drying.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Haoyuan serves a diverse customer base including global pharmaceutical giants such as Pfizer, Johnson & Johnson, Lilly, MSD, and Roche, as well as leading academic and research institutions like NIH, Tsinghua University, Peking University, Harvard, Oxford, and Cambridge. The company also collaborates with international distributors and CROs, providing products and services for drug discovery, preclinical research, clinical trials, and commercial production. Its markets span innovative drug development, generic drug manufacturing, and biochemical reagent supply.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with headquarters and multiple R&D and production centers in Shanghai, Anhui, Shandong, Jiangsu, and Chongqing. It has expanded internationally with subsidiaries and offices in the United States, Germany, Japan, and Hong Kong, and maintains sales and distribution networks covering North America, Europe, Japan, South Korea, Southeast Asia, and India. It has established warehouses and logistics centers in the US and Germany to support global distribution.
categories.supply_chain_position: Haoyuan operates across the pharmaceutical supply chain, covering upstream research materials (molecular building blocks and tool compounds), midstream pharmaceutical intermediates and APIs, and downstream drug formulation and manufacturing. It provides integrated CRO/CDMO services, enabling end-to-end support from drug discovery through clinical development to commercial production, positioning itself as a full-cycle service provider in the pharmaceutical supply chain.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes innovation-driven growth, focusing on expanding and upgrading its molecular building blocks and tool compounds portfolio, advancing biopharmaceutical reagents, and developing new molecular types such as ADCs, PROTACs, and nucleic acid drugs. It invests heavily in R&D centers across multiple locations, integrating AI technologies for compound design and screening, and enhancing GMP production capabilities. Strategic priorities include global market expansion, brand building, and deepening integrated CRO/CDMO service capabilities to accelerate drug development and commercialization.
categories.revenue_model: Haoyuan generates revenue primarily through product sales of molecular building blocks, tool compounds, biochemical reagents, pharmaceutical intermediates, APIs, and drug formulations. It also earns income from technical service contracts including FTE (full-time equivalent) and FFS (fee-for-service) models for drug discovery and development services. The company combines direct sales and distribution channels, leveraging proprietary brands and global sales networks to drive revenue growth.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Haoyuan is a leading integrated CRO/CDMO service provider in China’s pharmaceutical industry, particularly strong in small molecule drug discovery and manufacturing. It holds a competitive position domestically with significant international influence, especially in tool compounds and ADC payload-linker development. The company competes with other domestic and global pharmaceutical service providers by leveraging its comprehensive product portfolio, advanced technology platforms, and globalized sales and service networks.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, Haoyuan achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 1.88 billion, representing a 38.44% year-over-year increase. Net profit attributable to shareholders was RMB 127.45 million, a decline of 34.18% due to increased depreciation, asset impairment, and financial costs. Total assets grew 16.52% to RMB 4.19 billion, and net assets increased 8.15% to RMB 2.51 billion. The company maintains a robust growth trajectory with expanding R&D investment and global market penetration.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Haoyuan emphasizes its integrated end-to-end pharmaceutical service platform, combining innovative molecular building blocks, tool compounds, and biochemical reagents with advanced CDMO capabilities for APIs and formulations. Its differentiation lies in proprietary technology platforms, extensive product libraries, high-quality GMP manufacturing, and globalized brand presence. The company offers customized, high-value solutions that accelerate drug discovery and development, reduce costs, and improve time-to-market for clients worldwide.
